content: General pattern: an MIT LICENSE on a game repo covers code only by default; bundled sprite/art assets are commonly sourced from third-party packs (e.g. itch.io) under separate, possibly incompatible terms, and repos frequently omit a NOTICE file or per-asset attribution list. Confirmed for pixel-agents-hq/pixel-agents specifically: repo is MIT, and its character sprites are credited to JIK-A-4's 'MetroCity' itch.io pack, which is CC0 1.0 Universal (commercial use allowed, no attribution required) -- but this was verified only for that one named asset; other bundled assets in the fork still need individual audit before assuming CC0/MIT coverage.
